title: Elemental-role transferable LINK-XTB primitive-Hessian correction
summary: Extend the atom-type-free v3 correction by a registered comparison of three hydrogen roles and retain only a cross-molecule improvement.
coordinate_policy: Transform both harmonic Hessians on the same complete frozen R/A/L/SOOP/D primitive pool supplied by SMITH; experimental fundamentals are forbidden as targets.
backend_policy: Retain the v3 family/Mayer/SCC model and compare exactly three elemental hydrogen roles. Select at most one by whole-molecule validation RMS and use external saccharin only as confirmation. Atom types, element-pair tables and external-QM populations are forbidden.
